content:
If you like the new wallpaper Apple designed for iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max, you don't need to buy a new iPhone to use it. You can download it right now below.

Download the all-new iPhone 18 Pro wallpaper

Although the default iOS wallpaper is dynamic and reacts to the device's movement and operation, the versions below are static images extracted directly from the first iOS 27 Release Candidate.

The Release Candidate appears to not include the iPhone Duo wallpaper, so you may have to wait a few more weeks, possibly until iOS 27.1.

Remember to tap or click on the image to save the full-resolution wallpaper. Then, if you're using an iOS device, you can set it as your background through the Photos app or the Settings app.

For 9to5Mac's full coverage of Apple's "Surprise and Shine" event, please click this link.
